title: Chainsmoker Cat TV Anime Reveals Main Trailer, Theme Song Artists, More Staff Members
content: The staff for the television anime of Nyan Nyan Factory 's Chainsmoker Cat ( Yanineko ) manga revealed the anime's main promotional video, theme songs, and additional staff members on Sunday. The promo video previews the opening theme song "Nanmonee" by rock band Wasureranneyo .
author: ANN

title: Wasted Chef Anime Film Reveals Teaser Trailer, Manga Adaptation
content: The official website for director Takayuki Hirao 's ( Magical Sisters Yoyo & Nene ) Wasted Chef anime film project opened on Sunday and revealed its teaser trailer, and manga adaptation, which will launch in Kadokawa 's Young Ace magazine on June 4. Aero05 will draw the manga adaptation.
author: ANN

title: WASTED CHEF Original Anime Film by Pompo the Cinephile Director Takayuki Hirao Announced
content: KADOKAWA has announced a new original anime film from Pompo the Cinephile director Takayuki Hirao, referred to by the project code WASTED CHEF . The film revealed its first teaser trailer, visual, and main staff members on May 31.
author: Anime Corner

title: Perfect Addiction 'Light Anime' Reveals Promo Video
content: The official website for the "light anime" adaptation of Kaoruko Miyama 's Perfect Addiction boys-love manga revealed a promotional video on Wednesday. The anime will premiere in July. The anime stars Yōhei Azakami as Akihito Kuji (left in image at right), and Sōma Saitō as Sae Takatsuki.
author: ANN

title: 'Yani Neko' Reveals Additional Staff, Theme Songs, First Promo
content: The official website for the television anime adaptation of Nyannyan Factory 's Yani Neko ( Chainsmoker Cat ) manga revealed additional staff, theme songs, and a promotional video on Sunday. The anime is scheduled to premiere on July 3 at 12:30 a.m. on Tokyo MX and BS11, followed by AT-X.
author: MyAnimeList

title: Chainsmoker Cat Reveals Main Trailer
content: The previously announced Chainsmoker Cat revealed its main trailer on Sunday, along with the opening and ending theme songs. Studio Bibury Animation is animating the series, set to premiere on July 2. Wasureranneyo is performing the opening song while Necry Talkie is singing the ending song.
author: Anime Corner

title: Crunchyroll CEO Says Anime Creators Can Use Whatever Technology They Want but It’s a No for AI Subs and Dubs
content: Crunchyroll CEO Rahul Purini has spoken about the company’s attitude towards AI in the creative process. He shares that it’s down to the creators to use whatever technology they want, but for Crunchyroll, it doesn’t intend to use AI in its own creative processes of subtitling or dubbing.
author: Anime Corner

title: Anime’s Weirdest Crossover is Coming Sooner Than You Think
content: Throughout the history of anime, fans have seen quite a few franchises meet in some wild crossovers. The Z-Fighters have fought the Straw Hat Pirates, Devilman has tangled with Cyborg 009 , and even Hello Kitty has soared the spaceways to take on Mobile Suit Gundam .

title: Netflix Loves Gojo Just as Much as Jujutsu Kaisen Fans Do (Maybe More)
content: It turns out that while Jujutsu Kaisen fans have been thirsting over Satoru Gojo this entire time, Netflix just might love the famous icon much more than anime fans do after their love confession has gone viral.
